paper_title: Astrophysical limits on very light axion-like particles from Chandra grating spectroscopy of NGC 1275
notes: Astrophysical ALP-photon conversion limit from Chandra HETG spectroscopy of NGC 1275 in Perseus cluster. 99.7% credible region gives g_agamma < 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 (Model-A) and < 7.9e-13 GeV^-1 (Model-B) for m_a < 1e-12 eV. Encoded the tighter Model-A limit as a horizontal line spanning the validity range (masses up to ~1e-12 eV). Not a DM haloscope, so no local density assumed. The paper's model library spans log10(m_a/eV) in [-13.6,-11.1]. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 33)) | Vision: Traced HETG 99.7% exclusion boundary (Model-A, top panel of Fig 6) which is the lower edge of the light-blue excluded region. Flat plateau at ~6.3e-13 GeV^-1 for m_a < 1e-12 eV, rising to ~7.9e-13 with kinks, then a sharp dip near ~5e-12 eV (down to ~1.6e-13) followed by a steep rise above 4e-12 eV.
